name: loyalty-engine-mcp
description: Loyalty program tools: members, points, rewards, challenges, products and purchases.
long_description: A thin stdio wrapper around the deployed Loyalty Engine MCP server. The tools themselves run remotely and call the loyalty API over HTTPS; this bundle exists so Claude Desktop can install the connector in one click and show it with its own icon.

server_url.title: MCP endpoint
server_url.description: Full URL of the deployed server, ending in /mcp.

client_token.title: Client token
client_token.description: One of the tokens listed in the server's MCP_CLIENT_TOKENS. Its scopes decide which tools are allowed.
